newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIAN STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIAN STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: Turnover amounted to 564,540 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 582 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
